status: Modelled; moderate valuation gap, not extreme undervaluation
accounting_notes: One ADS equals one ordinary share. Starting cash deducts known July dividend of $35.6m from June cash; no invented July–September operating cash. $35m operating cash reserve is an assumption. $6m senior reserve=$1m repurchase payable+$5m remaining MiniPay commitments; no value assigned to MiniPay associates. Base OPay value is 75% of $300.9m carrying amount; downside zero, upside full carrying value, not an independent OPay valuation. Future EBIT retains SBC and cash rent; DA excludes ROU depreciation and leases are excluded from debt. No future award issuance or repurchase accretion: ongoing SBC is treated as cash-equivalent compensation, existing awards represented by Q2 diluted count. Capitalized development, equipment and allowance for noncash development additions are deducted in capex. Reported DA in history includes leases; forecast DA excludes them. No material defined-benefit pension or minority interest reported in reviewed statements.
